scope: Explicit closeout native follow-ups reviewed against the current canonical default family branches and generated consumer. Diagnostic overlay/form/dialog producer observations do not automatically run in browser-required-cells. This is an obligation inventory, not a browser verdict or release matrix change.

rows.current_canonical_assertion: Second tab aria-selected only; no ink-bar offsetLeft/offsetWidth alignment check.
rows.required: First/second/first measured active label and ink-bar alignment.

rows.current_canonical_assertion: Real DOM option click, public optionSelected value a, resulting input value a, and panel removal all required.
rows.required: Packed/native run on each supported line/runtime; broader lifecycle cases remain separate.

rows.current_canonical_assertion: Visible Hello tip plus separate ARIA lifetime check; no before/after wider-message rectangle check.
rows.required: Centered below-host measured geometry before/after wider message and viewport bounds.

rows.current_canonical_assertion: Shared actual-directive creation/destruction fixture; complete five-field observation required, bounded timeout and current-request identity.
rows.required: Packed/native actual legacy tooltip at both line/runtime subjects; source Core fixture proof is protocol scope.

rows.current_canonical_assertion: Panel presence only; no explicit trigger/pane/panel/option font or historical option height measurement.
rows.required: 20px trigger, actual pane/font propagation, and historical 3em option height60px.

rows.current_canonical_assertion: Filled field/hint presence; no outlined start/gap widths or prefix/hide/show/RTL transitions.
rows.required: All existing independent tagged outline arithmetic cases and source-authorized resource/geometry fixes; long-label cap and attachment rule remain open.

rows.current_canonical_assertion: Second tab selection; no narrow header initialization/pagination/inert disabled click/focus retention/scroll geometry.
rows.required: Existing pagination and selected ink-bar observations under packed native runtime.

rows.current_canonical_assertion: Container presence in globally disabled motion fixture; no enabled event/fallback delivery and completed disposal.
rows.required: Actual trusted CSS enter/exit, controlled missing-event fallback, one action dismissal/completion/removal and applicable deadlines; pending announcement destruction is separate.

rows.current_canonical_assertion: Automatic first-item activeElement containment required after actual trigger click; no manual focus bypass.
rows.required: Packed/native current first-focus behavior; destroy/supersede/reentrant/closed-owner cases remain distinct.

rows.current_canonical_assertion: Chip/list presence and general focus checks; no connected FormControl touched transition after DOM blur.
rows.required: Actual list focus and untouched-before/touched-after control state with real DOM focus movement.
